## The engine against its model, bit for bit

Revision `e967bf4fa`: **15,995 of 15,995 vectors equal**, 0 differing (FSIN 2,000, FCOS 2,000, FSINCOS 2,000, FPTAN 2,000, F2XM1 2,000, FYL2X 1,995, FYL2XP1 2,000, FPATAN 2,000). The longest instruction took 755 clocks in the engine and the mean was 374.1.
